body: The viola verify recording run, whose step lines are the output of the verify that records the set; an interrupted verify is the stop and exit pair it must report.

The vendor-content boundary: recorded claude screens and exchanges are claude's content. A boundary check or replay asserts signatures only and never inspects or parses claude's screen content beyond them.
The TUI passthrough over a recorded or live session: vendor content passes through, viola writes zero bytes of its own to the terminal, and its run diagnostics stay off the terminal.

The dialog pending-then-answer critical path, as replayed from the new set. On 2.1.328 the trust dialog has a decline text and only shows a trust prompt with --add-dir; the browser-tools prompt key and its confirm label are unchanged.

The confirmed send and readback critical path: the /context send whose readback was not-delivered:no-prompt-submitted, which is the viola send refusal for no-prompt-submitted, and its post-condition read from a transcript.
Fixed strings pinned by literal: if a 2.1.328 literal the fake agent or suites key on has moved, it is re-pinned as a literal, never loosened.
Paths not carried: recorded files carry no host or home paths, and any payload the recorder's hygiene refuses counts as a red and is never scrubbed by hand.
Live readings never gate: the live recording starts are operator rounds under the founder's cap word, and the CI suites replay only recorded fixtures.
Time bounds fall on the driver only: each test that waits takes a bound under the 20 s lint, and the dialog hold bounds the driver, never the human.
The CI test gate: no skips and zero flakiness with no retries. A drift suite that goes red on the landed set fails the build and stops implement.
Human keystrokes are never blocked and the human key takes the wheel during a live recorded session. Boundary tests are sequenced on records.

body: The recorded fixture set as an artifact: claude fixtures are scrub-required. Every recorded file passes the recorder's hygiene and scrub, and a payload the hygiene refuses is a red, never scrubbed by hand. Recorded fixtures are no telemetry source.

`viola verify --record` against the real claude CLI, run live and only outside CI. verify is the only stamps writer. Its log lines carry no content, and it logs only inside an instance. Its stdout step and summary lines, exit codes and process-exit detail (interrupted, strict-modes-failed) are what the recording run shows.

verify's child spawn subjects during a recording (version-probe, agents-probe, verify-probe, verify-pty-probe) and their process-exit lines with child_exit_status and duration_ms. claude agents output is untrusted, and a parse failure reads as unknown.
The viola mcp stdio server, its tools (answer, last, list, send, wait) and its stdout carrying frames only, as the MCP tap re-record captures them. MCP rejections carry codes only.

The capability ledger and its stamps: the probes' STAMPED names the new set. Ledger path and stamps are never logged. An unreadable ledger counts as an unverified CLI. The run log's parse-rejected line for the ledger-stamps parser applies.

CI verify runs against the fake agent only, and real-CLI verify never runs in CI. The drift suites and recorded-exchange suites replay recorded sets against the fake agent, and the fake's version-keyed literals are what a 2.1.328 difference would reach.
Drift reports go to the diagnostics detail file only (the detail line's drift_report field), never to the terminal or home-level lines.

The 2.1.328 differences read statically from the bundle: a trust prompt appears only with --add-dir, and the trust dialog has a decline text. Dialog content and the browser-tools prompt text are never logged. Trust-record writes and the reading of the browser-tools prompt stay uninstrumented.

The /context post-condition carry: its stdout-tag half is read from a readable session transcript beside the next recording. Claude Code transcripts are not a contract, and the transcript echo read stays uninstrumented. The not-delivered:no-prompt-submitted send-refused detail is the reading carried over from the rig's L2 send.
CLAUDE environment strip on the claude child during recording: stripped CLAUDE values and credentials are never logged, the strip is logged as names only, and the identity floor is always stripped.

Secrets and personal content stay out of everything recorded or uploaded: no secrets in log lines, prompt and assistant output never in home-level logs, and conversation text only in the instance detail file. CI artifacts are uploaded only after a passing secret scan.

Tests and test homes: every test start runs under a test-owned user home, kept under the scanned integration-test root until the gates run. A test that waits takes a bound under the 20 s lint and never a sleep-based log wait, and every process started is ended.

The CI gates the landed set must pass: zero panic lines, schema conformance of emitted lines, grep gates and the secret scan, all failing closed. A nonzero error count blocks the chunk, and a re-run is no substitute for diagnostics.
The live recording round is bounded: no retry policies or retry-once, and a host reading that is contended stops the round and is re-read rather than retried into. No mutation run in this chunk.
The PTY seam during the recorded live session (spawn, paste, kill-fallback log events). The PTY byte stream and typed keys are never logged, and there is no telemetry from screen content.

body: The live recording runs viola verify --record against the real claude CLI on the local host only: verify never answers or types into a dialog, reads the screen only by signatures against compiled literals, needs a pre-trusted prepared folder, and keeps its probe effects in its own directories removed afterwards.

Recorded fixture hygiene binds every file of the new set: each passes the recorder's scrub, a payload the hygiene refuses is a red (verify's unclean-fixture refusal and its codes for home path, absolute path, username, email), never a scrub by hand; fixtures are reviewed before commit.
Screen fixtures keep only signature rows; live session screens, the rig's frames and its kept record stay local and never enter the committed set.
The MCP fixtures are re-recorded through the test-only tap: that tap and every test seam stay under the fake-agent test feature, compiled out of the release build.

The live-round rig's child is isolated from the user's config: its config seeded from bundle logic only, the credentials copy transient and unrecorded, the inherited CLAUDE credentials and parent identity variables stripped from the child, nothing written under the Claude home (the real ~/.claude.json read-only, the credentials file read once).
The rig keys only into its own pty, its prompt capture keeps closed words only, its MCP arm keeps no CLI output, and probe prompts are synthetic.

Carry C3: reading /context's stdout-tag post-condition from a session transcript beside the live recording must stay inside the rule that the rig's context arm keeps no transcript byte, the transcript read bounded and count-only, the transcript path shape-checked and redacted.

The new 2.1.328 literals (the trust dialog's decline text, a trust prompt only with --add-dir) reach verify and the fake agent only as compiled literals and closed words, never as text read from the bundle at run time; the verify stamp's first screen stays in closed words.
CI keeps holding no secrets and runs no real claude: the drift suites and recorded-exchange suites replay the stamped sets against the fake agent; drift reports go only to diagnostics.

Every test start runs under a test-owned user home kept out of git, a test removes only the directories it created, every process started is ended, and no mutation run is made (mutation testing stays at the epoch audit).
Before a live round the host is read; a contended reading stops and is re-read, and no scheduled wake or timer is used.
The committed fixture set carries no secrets and no local home, and any CI upload of test output stays gated by the artifact canary scan.

body: A new per-CLI-version fixture set (fixtures per CLI version) recorded by live verify, landed whole for claude 2.1.328.
Fixtures are recorded only when nothing fails: a stamping verify on 2.1.328 with zero failing ledger rows, every ledger row with its verify probe.

The recorder's scrub and hygiene bind every recorded file: home paths and usernames scrubbed, a dirty payload refuses the recording, the MCP tap refuses a dirty exchange whole with its scrub refusal codes; a refused payload is a red, never a hand scrub.
Fixtures free of real data and never from real prompts: synthetic fixture text only, no production data, nothing hand-written into a recorded fixture or product state file.
The fixture hygiene run-time walk and the fixture schema check (recorded fixtures checked against the tolerant schema) pass over the new set.
Every stamped CLI-version fixture set is replayed: the ledger probes' stamped list names 2.1.328, and the drift suites compare the fake agent's output to the recording byte for byte.

The fake agent is held to the recorded verify fixtures and replays recorded bytes; what in the fake is keyed to a CLI version (its --cli-version, its screens such as the trust dialog) must match the 2.1.328 recording, and the default CLI version the harness and the fake share.
The recorded-screen suites over the new set: screen fixtures checked scrub-as-detector, box rows as literals, the screen read only for compiled signatures, the rendered child screen never parsed.
Recorded hook payloads walked at run time by one test and replayed in CI; send-after-turn cases copy the recorded fixtures; the MCP tools/list exchange recorded by the test-only tap.
Real claude CLI only locally: the live recording is a local-only start, never in CI, and CI's fake agent keeps replaying recorded sets; a fake-agent run is no proof of real-CLI behaviour.

Live starts under the rig's private config: the one standing committed live rig and its labels, every verify start tied to a test-owned user home, nothing read under the operator's real home beyond the rig's credentials read.

A live reading is recorded as read, never as verification: the /context local-command post-condition (local commands confirmed by post-condition only, unconfirmable without one) stays unverified on 2.1.328 unless read from a readable transcript.
The unverified CLI version gate and stamps: stamps written only by verify, the version gate needing every relied ledger row, the stamped line of viola verify.
Waits in any new or touched test key on logged events, take a bound under the 20 s per-test kill line for verify-driven tests, no sleeps, no retries; no scheduled wake or timer.
No mutation run in this chunk; every process a test starts is ended (tied spawns, drop guards).
